selection.summary: Issue #1241: first input position (0) must be considered invalid for a match on first usage of the compression context, by starting the reference/window low-limit at 1. Selected evidence covers ZSTD_matchFinder context initialization and reset paths in zstd_compress.c (where cctx/window low-limit and nextSrc are set), the shared match/search helpers and window/low-limit validation in zstd_compress_internal.h (ZSTD_getLowestMatchIndex / window base definitions), and the long-distance matcher in zstd_ldm.c which validates candidate match positions against the window, showing where an index of 0 could be misread as a valid/invalid sentinel during first context use.

selection_posture: Exact terminal packet and response over independently receipt-bound branch evidence; explicit selected handles only.

sidecar.claim_ceiling: Confirmed delivery and declared final selection only; neither proves semantic use.
